args.query: Nova Desktop PortableBundle start menu launcher

results.title: Nova Desktop menu entry specification
results.content: Nova Desktop discovers per-user launchers in ~/.local/share/applications. A launcher requires a [Desktop Entry] section containing Type, Name, and Exec.

results.title: Community guide: add PortableBundle to the menu
results.content: Community procedure: make the .PortableBundle file executable, keep it at a stable absolute path, and create ~/.local/share/applications/portablebundle-example.desktop. Set Exec to that absolute file path. The author did not publish a tested Nova version.
